target_outcomes: Write 8 STAR stories covering conflict, failure, impact, and learning
Deliver each story in under 3 minutes

modules.title: Full Mock Interview Loops
target_outcomes: Complete 2 full mock loops (coding, ML design, behavioral)
Identify and fix remaining gaps

strategist_mle_mle_mid_grounded.goal_summary: Transition from backend to mid-level Machine Learning Engineer in 10 weeks by closing deep learning fundamentals and ML system design gaps, leveraging distributed systems and Python strengths, and practicing FAANG-style MLE coding interviews.

modules.title: Core ML Concepts Refresher
modules.reason: Deep learning fundamentals is a listed weakness and requires a solid base in classical ML concepts first.
target_outcomes: Explain bias-variance, regularization, and evaluation metrics
Train and evaluate baseline models in scikit-learn

modules.title: Deep Learning Fundamentals
modules.reason: Deep learning fundamentals is a declared weakness central to MLE interviews.
target_outcomes: Derive backpropagation for an MLP
Implement and train CNN and transformer basics in PyTorch
Diagnose overfitting and optimization issues

modules.title: ML System Design Foundations
modules.reason: ML system design is a declared weakness and a core MLE interview round.
target_outcomes: Structure an ML design answer from problem framing to monitoring
Design feature pipelines, training, and serving architectures
Discuss offline vs online evaluation and drift

modules.title: ML Design Case Drills (ETA, Pricing, Recommendations)
target_outcomes: Practice end-to-end designs for ranking, ETA prediction, and fraud detection
Leverage distributed systems strength in serving scale discussions

modules.title: FAANG MLE Coding Interview Drills
target_outcomes: Solve Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix with DFS plus memoization
Solve Simplify Path with a stack
Complete medium/hard problems in 30-40 minutes

modules.title: Mock MLE Interviews and Behavioral Framing
target_outcomes: Complete two full mock loops
Craft a backend-to-ML transition narrative

strategist_mle_mle_senior_grounded.goal_summary: Prepare for a Senior ML Engineer loop in 6 weeks by closing gaps in ML system design at scale and leadership stories, plus FAANG-style coding practice.

modules.title: ML System Design at Scale
modules.reason: ML system design at scale is a declared weakness and a core senior MLE interview round.
target_outcomes: Design end-to-end ML systems (recommendation, ranking, fraud) with serving, monitoring, and retraining
Reason about latency, throughput, and cost trade-offs at scale
Deliver a structured 45-minute design walkthrough

modules.title: Senior Leadership Stories
modules.reason: Leadership stories are a declared weakness and senior loops weigh behavioral leadership signal heavily.
target_outcomes: Draft 6-8 STAR stories covering influence, conflict, mentorship, and ambiguity
Rehearse concise delivery with measurable impact

modules.title: FAANG MLE Coding Drills (Matrix DFS, Path Parsing)
modules.reason: Postmortem reports FAANG MLE loops include problems like Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix and Simplify Path.
target_outcomes: Solve memoized DFS on grids such as Longest Increasing Path
Solve stack-based string problems such as Simplify Path

modules.title: Full Mock Senior MLE Loop
target_outcomes: Complete a mock loop combining design, coding, and behavioral rounds
Identify remaining gaps for final review

strategist_mle_mle_intern_grounded.goal_summary: Prepare a beginner for an ML Engineer internship in 14 weeks by closing data structures and deep learning fundamentals gaps, building on existing Python and linear algebra strengths.

modules.title: Core Data Structures in Python
modules.reason: Data structures is a declared weakness and a core part of MLE coding interviews.
target_outcomes: Implement arrays, hash maps, stacks, queues, and linked lists
Analyze time and space complexity with Big-O

modules.title: Trees, Graphs, and Traversal
modules.reason: Graph and grid traversal build directly on the declared data structures weakness and appear frequently in interviews.
target_outcomes: Implement BFS and DFS on trees, graphs, and grids
Apply memoization to grid DFS problems

modules.title: FAANG MLE-style Coding Drills
target_outcomes: Solve Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix using DFS with memoization
Solve Simplify Path using a stack
Practice timed problem solving with verbal explanation

modules.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals Refresher
target_outcomes: Explain supervised learning, loss functions, and gradient descent
Understand bias-variance and overfitting

modules.title: Deep Learning Fundamentals
modules.reason: Deep learning fundamentals is a declared weakness and central to ML engineering roles.
target_outcomes: Derive backpropagation for a multilayer perceptron
Explain activations, initialization, regularization, and optimizers
Describe CNNs, RNNs, and transformer basics

modules.title: Hands-on Neural Networks with PyTorch
modules.reason: Practical implementation solidifies the deep learning fundamentals weakness and is expected of intern candidates.
target_outcomes: Build and train an MLP and a CNN in PyTorch
Debug training loops and evaluate models

modules.title: Mock Interviews and ML Concept Q&A
target_outcomes: Complete timed mock coding interviews
Answer common ML/DL conceptual questions clearly
